extracted.name: Slow Cooked Goose
extracted.description: A delicious goose dinner with savory veggie-packed gravy that's so easy to prepare, it practically makes itself! The gravy is great over mashed potatoes.
instruction_lines: Combine celery, carrots, cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, mushrooms, sage, rosemary, and thyme in a large bowl.
Put goose pieces in a slow cooker. Pour vegetable-soup mixture over the goose.
Cook on High until goose is tender, 6 to 8 hours.
